module: Node "Move Vehicle To" (category `repeat_instant`, tags rotation/position/teleport/move). Moves a vehicle. Input pins: `vehId`, `pos` (vec3), `rot` (quat), and hidden pins `safeTeleport`, `centerVehicle`, `repairVehicle` (default true if nil). Then triggers the `trackVehReset` hook.
notes: With `repairVehicle` true/nil: `safeTeleport` -> `spawn.safeTeleport` (rotation corrected by `* quat(0,0,-1,0)`), otherwise `vehicleSetPositionRotation` (not centered, raw quaternion). With `repairVehicle` false: always `safeTeleport` without repair.
Called every frame while the flow is active: the vehicle is repositioned every frame.
Exits without doing anything if `pos` does not have 3 components.

C.desc: Flowgraph node class (returned by `_flowgraph_createNode(C)`). Definition fields: name, description, category, pinSchema, tags.

resetVehicle.desc: Moves the vehicle according to `pos`/`rot` and the options, then `extensions.hook('trackVehReset')`.
